objective: Choose a corrective transmission switching action that removes post-contingency overloads without islanding the network.

title.en: GAP-TASK-002 — Corrective transmission switching after contingency
title.ru: GAP-TASK-002 — Корректирующие переключения в передающей сети после аварии

objective.en: Given a post-contingency DC network state with one overloaded branch, choose at most one candidate switching action that restores all emergency line limits without islanding.
objective.ru: Для послеаварийного состояния DC-сети с перегруженной ветвью выберите не более одного допустимого переключения, которое устранит все перегрузки без разделения сети на острова.

instructions.en: Use the bus injections, branch reactances/ratings, and candidate switches to run or implement a DC power-flow check. Return close_branches/open_branches in submission.json; reported flows are optional and are independently recomputed by the evaluator.
instructions.ru: Используйте узловые инъекции, реактивности/допустимые токи ветвей и список допустимых переключений, чтобы выполнить DC power-flow. Верните close_branches/open_branches в submission.json; указанные потоки необязательны и пересчитываются оценивателем независимо.

public_inputs.contingency: Branch l13 is out of service after the initiating contingency. Branch l14 is an available normally-open tie that may be closed as a corrective action.
public_inputs.dc_power_flow_model: Lossless DC model. Bus p_mw injections sum to zero. Branch flow is (theta_from - theta_to) / x_pu. Slack bus is the first bus listed.
public_inputs.candidate_switches: Only branches listed in candidate_switches may be opened or closed. Use at most switching_budget actions.

branches.role: initiating contingency outage; not a corrective candidate

submission_schema.close_branches: list[str] of candidate branch ids to close
submission_schema.open_branches: list[str] of candidate branch ids to open
submission_schema.reported_flows_mw: optional object branch_id -> MW, diagnostic only

hard_constraints: Use at most one corrective switching action.
Only branches listed in candidate_switches may be opened or closed.
The resulting topology must remain connected; islanding is infeasible.
Every active branch loading must be at or below 100% of its emergency rating under the DC power-flow model.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: True when the switching action satisfies budget, candidate, connectivity, and line-loading constraints.

metrics.name: score
metrics.description: Normalized score based on feasibility, switch count, and max loading versus enumerated feasible actions.

metrics.name: max_loading_pct
metrics.description: Maximum absolute branch loading after the submitted switching action.

metrics.name: switch_count
metrics.description: Number of corrective switching actions used.

source_provenance.title: Security Constrained Unit Commitment with Corrective Transmission Switching
source_provenance.notes: Supports the operational framing: post-contingency corrective switching can relieve security violations while preserving network feasibility. This public case is a compact DC power-flow adaptation, not a reproduction of the paper's full SCUC MILP.

source_provenance.title: V4 balanced core shortlist — GAP-TASK-002
source_provenance.notes: Selects corrective transmission switching as a balanced-core task family for transmission operations and contingency management.
